The APR is the yearly rate at which your payments, including mortgage insurance, repay exactly the amount financed: the loan minus the charges you pay up front.

What moves the APR above the note rate

Each line adds one group of charges to the one before, so you can see which costs widen the gap most.

Which fees are finance charges

Sorted under Regulation Z, 12 CFR 1026.4. Only finance charges feed the APR.

FeeAmountFinance charge?Rule

Title, document, notary, credit report and appraisal fees stay out of the APR only if they are bona fide and reasonable. A third-party fee becomes a finance charge when the lender requires the service and keeps part of the fee, and closing-agent fees count when the lender requires that particular service or charge (12 CFR 1026.4(a)(1)–(2)). Your Loan Estimate shows the lender's own figure.
